integrity: The infinite parameter ranges are proved from the published exponent-order separation and the coefficient of magnitude seven. All exceptional parameters are expanded exactly. The finite verifier is a regression check, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the L-space-knot status of the nonzero L9a20 twist-family members. It does not determine hyperbolicity, fibering, strong quasipositivity, or the full knot Floer complexes.
title: No L-space knots in the L9a20 surgery-twin families
